newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL JULY CAR OUTPUT DOWN 6.0 PCT - ANFAVEA.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL JULY CAR OUTPUT DOWN 6.0 PCT - ANFAVEA.

text.p: Brazil produced 172,221 vehicles in July, down 6.0 percent from the previous month, Brazil's Motor Manufacturers Association (Anfavea) said on Wednesday.
Production in July, however, rose a slight 0.2 percent compared with the same month last year.
In the first seven months of the year, car output totaled 1.203 million vehicles, up 19.5 percent over the same period of 1996, Anfavea said.
Last month, automakers sold 144,033 vehicles in Brazil, down 5.7 percent from June, but up 3.5 percent compared with July 1996.
In the January-to-July period, 989,070 vehicles were sold in the domestic market, 18.4 percent more than a year ago, it said.
Brazil vehicle exports in July fell 9.1 percent to 30,219 vehicles compared with June and 12.8 percent compared with the same month last year, it added.
